causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Victoria experienced its second day of extreme heat, with temperatures reaching 43oC in Melbourne. This drove high demand (1100 MW below the 2009 record level) for electricity in Victoria.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Wind generation in both regions was below forecast, reducing potential supply of electricity in both regions.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Energy Australia advised AEMO that it would be taking its 355 MW Yallourn unit 4 out of service for planned maintenance from 19 January for a period of seven days.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Energy Australia's Yallourn unit 3 experienced a boiler tube leak at about 1.30 am on 25 January and reduced available capacity in Victoria by a further 355 MW.

causes.label: administered_pricing_or_intervention
causes.quote: AEMO activated the Reliability Emergency Reserve Trader (RERT) at around 9 am until 4.30 pm and so 'what-if' pricing applied for this period.

interconnectors_named.name: Heywood
interconnectors_named.quote: Victoria is connected to South Australia via two interconnectors - Heywood and Murraylink, while Victoria is connected to New South Wales via the Victoria - New South Wales (VIC - NSW) interconnector, and to Tasmania via Basslink.

interconnectors_named.name: Murraylink
interconnectors_named.quote: Victoria is connected to South Australia via two interconnectors - Heywood and Murraylink, while Victoria is connected to New South Wales via the Victoria - New South Wales (VIC - NSW) interconnector, and to Tasmania via Basslink.

interconnectors_named.name: VIC-NSW
interconnectors_named.quote: Victoria is connected to South Australia via two interconnectors - Heywood and Murraylink, while Victoria is connected to New South Wales via the Victoria - New South Wales (VIC - NSW) interconnector, and to Tasmania via Basslink.

interconnectors_named.name: Basslink
interconnectors_named.quote: Victoria is connected to South Australia via two interconnectors - Heywood and Murraylink, while Victoria is connected to New South Wales via the Victoria - New South Wales (VIC - NSW) interconnector, and to Tasmania via Basslink.

intervals.quote: Spot prices exceeded $5000/MWh for the 11 am and 11.30 am trading intervals in Victoria, and in the 11.30 am trading interval in South Australia.
intervals.text: 11 am and 11.30 am trading intervals in Victoria, and 11.30 am trading interval in South Australia

peak_price.quote: reaching $7433/MWh at 11 am and $14 500/MWh at 11.30 am in Victoria and $11 340/MWh at 11.30 am in South Australia.

rebid_set_price.quote: Rebidding from low to high prices did not contribute to high price outcomes. In fact, generators rebid capacity from high to low prices throughout the day.
